title: AI for Fraud Detection in NGO Operations: Bringing Trust with Data-Driven Governance
summary: Researchers propose automated NGO verification, transaction monitoring, and audits. Fraud and audit-efficiency improvements are projections.
source_collection: ITU AI for Good: Innovate for Impact (2025)
account: Researchers propose a pilot of automated NGO verification, transaction monitoring, and audits. Fraud and audit-efficiency improvements are projections.
purpose: Identify suspicious registrations, financial transactions, and project claims.

ratings.reason: NGOs, auditors, and funders are intended to improve oversight; the 30% fraud reduction and 50% faster auditing are expected.
More accountable use of charitable and public money is intended, with no prevented loss established.

ai_role.statement: The project account does not separately evaluate AI’s contribution to the benefit.

evidence.citation: Project account in International Telecommunication Union, AI for Good: Innovate for Impact, 2025. Information current as of June 2025. Outcomes are reported by the project team. The account provides no independent outcome evaluation.
